text.title: FreshDrop, July–August 2026 cohorts, weekly active buyers
text.acquisition: 6,200 new installs in July: 58% referral, 42% paid ads; CAC 1,150 RUB
text.activation: 38% of new buyers place a first order within 3 days
text.retention: 41% of first-time buyers order again within 30 days
text.referral: 12% of buyers invite a friend; 1 in 4 invitees orders
text.revenue: 2,450 RUB average spend per buyer per month
text.acquisition_compare: July target 6,000 installs; CAC target 1,000 RUB
text.bottleneck: activation: 38% of new users make a first order; benchmark 55%; the address step loses most users
text.decision: simplify the address form and show the delivery time before sign-up; check activation after 4 weeks
